_comment: Everything Isaac has made. The homepage 'Latest' cell and the /made/ page read this file. Add new entries to the TOP. Fields: slug (folder name under /made/), title, kind (short label), date (YYYY-MM-DD, when it was built or first shipped), summary (one or two sentences), image (screenshot path), url (live version), story (true once /made/<slug>/ exists), archived (true once a copy lives at /made/<slug>/app/).
